column1: # Secret patterns masked in hook and CLI logs — the one source for both
# Format: <gitleaks rule id><TAB><regex>. Lines starting with # and blank lines are skipped.
# Patterns are applied in file order, so a specific rule must precede a broader one
# that would also match it (anthropic before openai).
# Each regex must mean the same thing as POSIX ERE (bash [[ =~ ]]) and Python `re`:
# use bracket classes, [.] for a literal dot, {m,n}; no \d \s \w, lookarounds,
# (?i), lazy quantifiers or backreferences. Nothing may match the empty string,
# and no pattern may match its own replacement "[REDACTED:<rule id>]".
